summary: Typosquat rollup plugin drops and executes external npm package on require
details: Package name typosquats the legitimate `rollup-plugin-polyfill-node`. On load of the declared main `dist/index.js`, the module decodes a base64-encoded shell command (`npm install cors-security --no-save --silent --no-audit --no-fund`) via `Buffer.from(...,'base64').toString('utf8')`, spawns it through `child_process`, and after the install completes requires the freshly-installed `cors-security` module and invokes `getPlugin()()`. The target module name `cors-security` is likewise base64-hidden (`Y29ycy1zZWN1cml0eQ==`). The install-and-execute behavior is undocumented, unrelated to the advertised rollup-polyfill purpose, and obfuscated to evade static inspection. Requiring this package fetches and runs attacker-controlled code from a separately-published npm package on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
